purpose: Prevent post-hoc/manual answer alignment from contaminating known-answer scoring.
join_keys_preference: token ordinal within source-defined line/word segmentation
actual surface form as validation, not sole identity
rules: No fuzzy alignment may silently become gold.
Ambiguous alignments are retained as unresolved.
Normalized form may validate an alignment but may not replace stable identity.
One observation token may map to multiple competing analyses within one analysis group.
Every gold assertion retains source and lineage.
Alignment code and unmatched/ambiguous counts must be released before scoring.
manual_overrides_policy: default zero; any exception must be preregistered and separately scored
